notes.title: Caveman Jump Jump is Coming this Friday!
notes.content:
[p]The day is set! [/p][p][/p][p]This friday Caveman Jump Jump goes live !
[/p][p]After a long development process, we're thrilled to finally launch the first version of [b]Caveman Jump Jump[/b]. We can't wait to push the "publish now" button and share this game with all of you.[/p][p]We want to thank you all for your incredible patience and kind support over these past months. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we've used it to ensure this game is as fun as it can possibly be![/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey. [/p][p]We're eager to hear your feedback once you've had a chance to play and see if you can beat the game.[/p][p]See you soon with the next updates![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545761/4c10f597cf0dec8055370b550f49b488681824a4.jpg"][/img][/p]
